phev_battery_replacement_policy.formula: clip(lifetime km * electric utility factor * electric-mode net stored kJ/km / 3600 / nominal kWh / cycle life - 1, 0, 3)
phev_battery_replacement_policy.cycle_basis: equivalent full cycles of nominal capacity; no additional DoD divisor
phev_battery_replacement_policy.energy_boundary: inherited net stored-energy approximation; not gross charge/discharge throughput
phev_battery_replacement_policy.explicit_inputs: nonzero counts retained for the whole pack; conflicting PHEV inputs rejected

hydrogen_compression_adaptation.delivery source: Premise hydrogen supply, distributed by pipeline: arrives at 30 bar
hydrogen_compression_adaptation.boundary: Tank compression after pipeline delivery; pipeline preparation remains in hydrogen supply

cng_supply_basis.source: ecoinvent vehicle-grade natural gas market comment
cng_supply_basis.policy: Preserve model energy and source compression recipe; upstream gas energy is not delivered LHV

defaults: Current 2020 cycle-specific load/mileage, sizing, lifetime and replacement values
proxy_policy: Energy-preserving gasoline/LPG conversions approved by user 2026-10-13; retained diesel/diesel-hybrid/CNG manufacture and non-CO2 factors explicitly documented

phev_replacement_correction.policy: Truck net lifetime electric energy is weighted before subtracting the first pack; cars use the approved 200000 vehicle-km and 18-year limits; each count belongs to the physical pack
